counterfactual_training.finding: All-action enumeration solved R29's rescue-coverage collapse: 298 rescue examples were retained, including thousands of uncertified alternative-action rows. Coverage is no longer the primary bottleneck.

rescue_guard.finding: No preregistered threshold pair separated rescue from harm. At rescue threshold 0.45 / harm ceiling 0.05 the selector chose 185 actions with 21 rescues and 15 harms (11.35% rescue precision); stricter thresholds reduced coverage without approaching the locked cross-block precision and zero-harm gate.

interpretation: The failure moved again: candidate coverage and certification filtering are no longer limiting, but local public/action/consequence features remain insufficient to identify terminal rescue safely. The accepted R4 recurrent/latent internal representation was not exposed to the R30 rescue classifier and is the next preregistered variable to test.
